ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-contrast dark pigmentation dominates approximately 95% of the visible surface area, with sparse high-intensity white pixel clusters contributing to the remaining 5%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous low-intensity (black) field. High-contrast (white) geometric blobs are concentrated at the distal lateral coordinates of both lobes. Stochastic high-intensity points are distributed across the central and lower regions of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to lobe height of 1:8.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular sawtooth topography across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by sharp peaks and valleys with a recurring pixel amplitude of 5-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves extending laterally from the median notch, reaching maximum vertical extent at the mid-lobe before descending toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups located at the extreme outer edges (tips) of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) predominantly oriented vertically in the lower-central region of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated scarring at the terminal ends of both lobes, resulting in irregular, high-contrast white textural clusters.
